description: This PHP test class for the EmploymentStatusDao in the OrangeHRM system contains unit tests for CRUD operations and search functionality related to employment statuses. It sets up test fixtures, verifies method outputs, and tests data persistence and retrieval methods.

classes.name: EmploymentStatusDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing EmploymentStatusDao methods within the OrangeHRM application.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, including creating an instance of EmploymentStatusDao and populating test data from fixtures.

methods.name: testGetEmploymentStatusesList
methods.description: Verifies that the getEmploymentStatuses method returns a list of three employment status entries.

methods.name: testGetEmploymentStatusById
methods.description: Checks that retrieving employment status by ID returns an object with the expected name.

methods.name: testDeleteEmploymentStatus
methods.description: Tests the deletion of multiple employment statuses by their IDs and confirms the correct number was deleted.

methods.name: testSearchEmploymentStatus
methods.description: Ensures that searching employment statuses returns three EmploymentStatus objects.

methods.name: testSearchEmploymentStatusWithLimit
methods.description: Checks that search with a limit parameter on results returns only two employment statuses.

methods.name: testSaveEmploymentStatus
methods.description: Verifies that saving a new EmploymentStatus with name 'Permanent' returns an object with that name.

methods.name: testEditEmploymentStatus
methods.description: Tests updating an existing EmploymentStatus's name and confirms the changes are persisted.

methods.name: testGetEmploymentStatuses
methods.description: Repeats the getEmploymentStatuses check to ensure consistent retrieval.

methods.name: testGetSearchEmploymentStatusesCount
methods.description: Verifies that the count of employment statuses matching search criteria is 3.
